summary.zh: 中国分布最广的大型竹，竹海与竹笋的主角。
summary.en: The most widespread large bamboo in China; the star of bamboo seas and spring shoots.

field_marks.zh: 秆高可达 20 m，秆环平，节间有粉；笋壳有褐色斑点和毛。
field_marks.en: Culms up to 20 m with waxy internodes; shoot sheaths are brown-spotted and hairy.

story.zh: 竹类属于禾本科的一个分支，却长成树的形态。毛竹基因组显示竹类经历过古多倍化。竹子开花周期极长（以数十年计）且常同步，是进化生态学上的有趣现象。
story.en: Bamboos are a branch of the grass family that evolved a tree-like habit. The moso genome records an ancient polyploidy. Flowering cycles are very long (decades) and often synchronised.

note.zh: 毛竹（异名 P. heterocycla）基因组草图。

notes.zh: 春笋期约 3–5 月；全年常绿，雨后与晨雾中尤其出片。竹海区域步道多湿滑。
notes.en: Shoot season runs roughly March–May; evergreen year-round and especially photogenic in mist. Trails through bamboo are often slippery.
